      - main:
        - text: FINANCIAL MATHEMATICS & MODELLING
        - heading "Effective Interest Rate" [level=1]
        - paragraph: Convert nominal APR to true annual growth (EAR) and compare compounding frequencies.
        - text: "Level: Intermediate-Advanced Applied Modelling Lab 6-10 min Workspace"
      - complementary:
        - text: OBJECTIVE
        - paragraph: Understand how compounding frequency increases the effective annual rate (EAR), learn the rule, and apply it confidently.
      - navigation:
        - button "Interact"
        - button "Learn"
        - button "Worked Example"
        - button "Formula"
        - button "Practice"
        - button "Reset all":
          - img
          - text: Reset all
      - text: OBSERVE & MANIPULATE
      - paragraph: Change the nominal rate and compounding to see the effect on the future value.
      - complementary:
        - text: Nominal APR (r)
        - slider "Nominal APR (r) slider": "12"
        - spinbutton "Nominal APR (r)": "12"
        - text: "% 0 30"
        - group "Compounding per year (n)":
          - text: Compounding per year (n)
          - button "1"
          - button "2"
          - button "4"
          - button "12"
          - button "52"
          - button "365"
        - text: Principal (P) ₹
        - spinbutton "Principal (P)": "10000"
        - text: Time (t)
        - spinbutton "Time (t)": "1"
        - text: years
      - main:
        - heading "Accumulation over time (t = 1 year)" [level=2]
        - text: EAR (effective annual rate)
        - button "₹11,200.00 n = 1 (Yearly)":
          - strong: ₹11,200.00
          - text: n = 1 (Yearly)
        - button "₹11,236.00 n = 2 (Semiannually)":
          - strong: ₹11,236.00
          - text: n = 2 (Semiannually)
        - button "₹11,255.09 n = 4 (Quarterly)":
          - strong: ₹11,255.09
          - text: n = 4 (Quarterly)
        - button "₹11,268.25 n = 12 (Monthly)":
          - strong: ₹11,268.25
          - text: n = 12 (Monthly)
        - button "₹11,273.41 n = 52 (Weekly)":
          - strong: ₹11,273.41
          - text: n = 52 (Weekly)
        - button "₹11,274.75 n = 365 (Daily)":
          - strong: ₹11,274.75
          - text: n = 365 (Daily)
      - term: Future Value A
      - definition: ₹11,268.25
      - text: with n = 12
      - term: Effective Annual Rate (EAR)
      - definition: 12.6825%
      - text: = (A/P) - 1
      - term: Extra vs yearly
      - definition: ₹68.25
      - text: (0.6825%)
      - term: Formula
      - definition:
        - text: EAR = (1 + r/n)
        - superscript: "n"
        - text: "- 1"
      - paragraph: ⓘ As compounding frequency increases, the effective annual rate increases.
      - article:
        - heading "NOTICE THE PATTERN" [level=3]
        - paragraph: ✓ More frequent compounding compounds interest on interest more often.
        - paragraph: ✓ Future value increases and approaches a limit.
        - paragraph: ✓ Extra gain over yearly compounding keeps growing but gets smaller.
      - article:
        - heading "UNDERSTAND THE RULE" [level=3]
        - paragraph: The effective annual rate for nominal annual rate r, compounded n times per year is given by
        - strong:
          - text: EAR = (1 + r/n)
          - superscript: "n"
          - text: "- 1"
        - paragraph: where r is in decimal and n is a positive integer.
      - article:
        - heading "COMMON MISCONCEPTION" [level=3]
        - paragraph: "Incorrect: EAR = r (or EAR = n × r)"
        - paragraph: This ignores compounding on interest and significantly underestimates the true growth.
        - paragraph: "Example: r = 12%, n = 12 → EAR is 12.6825%."
      - heading "WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Find the effective annual rate (EAR) if the nominal APR is 10% compounded monthly.
      - paragraph: Given r = 10% = 0.10 n = 12 t = 1 year
      - paragraph:
        - text: Solution EAR = (1 + 0.10/12)
        - superscript: "12"
        - text: "- 1 = 0.1047135745..."
        - strong: = 10.4714% (approx.)
      - paragraph: Check Future value on ₹10,000 in 1 year A = ₹11,047.14 EAR = (A/P) - 1 = 10.4714% ✓
      - heading "TRY INDEPENDENTLY" [level=3]
      - paragraph: "Challenge: Equivalent-rate matcher. Match each nominal rate with its compounding frequency that gives the EAR shown."
      - text: 1 10% APR → 10.4713%
